result.summary: The intersection is a wide commercial corridor with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and a high-visibility continental crosswalk on the side street. However, the multi-lane configuration and wide corner radii prioritize vehicle throughput, creating significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The crosswalk spans multiple lanes without a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right, across the side street

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The large radius at the corner encourages higher vehicle speeds during right turns, increasing risk to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages, reducing exposure time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide, multi-lane roadway lacks a median refuge, forcing pedestrians to cross a significant distance in a single stage through a vehicle-dominated environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large dark pickup truck parked or stopped near the corner may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
